item.title: Forecasting for Hybrid PV/Wind/Battery Microgrids
item.description: Short- and medium-term forecasting models for wind speed, solar irradiance, load, and battery state of charge, integrated into the energy management strategy of a hybrid PV/wind/battery microgrid to improve energy efficiency and dynamic control performance. M.Sc. thesis, Amirkabir University of Technology (2022).

item.title: Optimization-Based MPPT under Partial Shading
item.description: A bio-inspired maximum power point tracking algorithm, simulated and implemented to maximize power extraction from photovoltaic panels under partial shading, outperforming the conventional perturb-and-observe method.
